rules.description: Boolean fuzzy-tolerance change (PR #29984, PD: Add FuzzyTolerance property, in main from 2026-05-18; not backported to releases/FreeCAD-1-1) shifts this body's volume ~0.24%. main matches the 0.21 baseline to 3e-8; the 1.1.x line still carries the pre-#29984 value. Scoped to Body002 (the affected body) so volume regressions on the other bodies still fail.
App::Part aggregate carries Body002's volume difference on the FreeCAD 1.1.x line (see the Body002 rule; root cause PR #29984, absent from releases/FreeCAD-1-1). Main matches the baseline to 3e-8.
